title: Senior Content Writer (B2B SaaS)
description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts.

We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast.

First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet.

On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing.

This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree
  • Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality.
  • Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples.
  • You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday
  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.
  • You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop.
  • You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress
  • Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation
  • You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine.
  • Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

  • You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. You work closely with two marketing managers and directly with our founders.
  • Own a growth bet from scratch. Benchmark reports will carry your name and go out to industry bodies, journalists and analysts.
  • Go deep on subjects most marketers never touch. You leave here knowing more about inspections, audits and frontline operations than almost anyone in the market.
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. If you have written something you are proud of, a benchmark report, a deeply researched piece, anything that took real work, send it along.

Our Hiring Process

  • First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes)
  • Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder
  • We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step)

title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics

Your tasks

  • Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship.

  • Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended.
  • Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next.
  • Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging.
  • From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly.
  • Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs.


Your profile

  • Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half.
  • Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people.
  • Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be.
  • Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic.
  • Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models.
  • Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement.


Why us?

  • Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers.

  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

How to Apply

Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production: what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) - Team Search
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

Flix is building the global platform for affordable and sustainable ground travel, from next-generation train offerings in Europe to rapid expansion in high-growth markets such as India. As our network becomes broader and more complex, Search plays a critical role in helping millions of customers find the right journey quickly, confidently, and intuitively.

As a Senior Product Owner/Manager in Demand Division you will be able to turn Search into a true growth engine for Flix: a product experience that understands customer intent, reduces complexity, improves conversion, and creates valuable demand signals for the business across web, app, and emerging AI-native channels.

In this role, you will define the north star for Flix Search and own the roadmap through a major product and technical transformation. You will work closely with engineering, UX, data, commercial, and operational stakeholders to evolve Search from a functional step in the booking funnel into a personalised, intelligent, and scalable discovery experience.

About the Role

  • Set and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy for Search, grounded in customer needs, business impact, and market opportunity
  • Identify and prioritise opportunities across ranking, relevance, comparison, query understanding, personalisation, and zero-result recovery
  • Use data such as conversion impact, query behaviour, and customer feedback to diagnose problems and guide product decisions
  • Lead discovery and delivery with cross-functional teams, balancing quick customer-facing improvements with long-term platform and architectural needs
  • Align stakeholders around trade-offs, success metrics, and roadmap priorities in an ambiguous and strategically important product area
  • Explore how Search can support new surfaces and behaviours, including AI-native discovery and conversational travel planning

About You

  • You have 8+ years of product management experience, ideally including ownership of a search, discovery, marketplace, recommendation, or other high-intent digital product
  • You have led meaningful product changes in complex environments and can connect product strategy with hands-on execution
  • You are highly data-informed and know how to turn behavioural, funnel, and query-level insights into clear product direction
  • You are comfortable partnering with engineering on technical topics such as APIs, ranking, machine learning, performance, and architectural trade-offs
  • You are a strong communicator who can build trust across engineering, UX, data, and business teams and create alignment when priorities compete
  • You are energised by unsolved problems and motivated to understand why a customer experience is not working, not only how to close the next ticket
  • You are fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel, mobility, marketplaces, e-commerce, or other high-scale consumer platforms
  • Experience building or improving AI-assisted, personalised, or conversational discovery experiences
  • German or another European language skills

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Wir entwickeln gemeinsam mit dir deine Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte.

  • Du strebst das Steuerberater- / Wirtschaftsprüferexamen an oder bist bereits Berufsträger
  • Gute EDV-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen
  • Macher-Qualitäten! Deine überzeugende und stets offene Persönlichkeit sowie dein naturgemäß unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln schaffen dir Akzeptanz bei Mandanten und im Team

Benefits

Wertschätzung. Flexibilität. Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen.
Was wir dir bieten.

Wer einmal bei NICKEL startet, bleibt meist langfristig Teil unseres Teams – und das aus gutem Grund. Wir schaffen für jedes Teammitglied ein passendes Arbeitsumfeld und berücksichtigen individuelle Bedürfnisse. Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen, deshalb bieten wir dir eine breite Palette an attraktiven Vorteilen:

  • Flexibilität: Home-Office & flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Attraktive Vergütung
  • Persönliches und wertschätzendes Miteinander
  • Anrechnung und Ausgleich von Überstunden
  • Sehr gute Karrierechancen durch spannende Mandate und vielfältige Entwicklungsangebote
  • Zeitliche und finanzielle Unterstützung von Weiterbildungen
  • Förderung durch regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche und persönlichen Mentor
  • Modernes Office mit stylischen Räumlichkeiten und optimaler Verkehrsanbindung mit Auto, Bus und Bahn
  • Coole Teamevents (z.B. eigener Food Truck)
  • Hoher Digitalisierungsgrad (wir „zwingen“ Mandate zur Digitalisierung)
  • Moderne Hard- und Software (defektes wird sofort ersetzt und auf individuelle Wünsche eingegangen)

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

We have a clear vision for how we want to build software and the outcomes we want to achieve, while recognising that we're still on the journey to get there. Some foundations are already in place; others are still evolving. We're looking for someone who has built and scaled complex systems before and can bring that experience into what we build.

Our customers are tradespeople. Every hour they spend on paperwork is an hour off the job site. We keep that in mind when making technical decisions: the systems we build should ultimately help us take more work off their plate.

  • How we build with AI. You'll influence both how we develop and evaluate customer-facing AI capabilities and how AI changes software engineering itself — from tooling and workflows to standards and practices across the organisation.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You'll have meaningful autonomy from the start:

  • Shape technical direction. You'll evolve shared architecture and engineering standards through RFCs and ADRs, not by waiting for top-down decisions.

  • Own complex initiatives end to end. From discovery and technical design through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Influence where Engineering invests. You'll help identify the technical capabilities, architectural improvements, and engineering practices worth investing in.

  • Raise the bar across teams. You'll shape architecture, developer experience, AI-enabled engineering practices, and codebase quality beyond your immediate team.

  • Multiply other engineers. You'll mentor through collaboration, architectural guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

How hands-on you are depends on the problem. Some weeks you'll be deep in the code; others you'll focus on system design, technical discovery, or mentoring across teams. We care about the technical outcomes you create, not your commit count.

Your Profile

  • AI- and agentic-build competencies. You have designed, built, shipped, or operated AI-enabled or agentic product systems beyond prompts alone: retrieval and knowledge design, evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour, observability of model- and tool-driven flows, and debugging across multi-step agent traces. You know what it takes to move these systems from promising demos into reliable product experiences, and you can help others build the judgement to use them safely.

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.

title: Senior SAP SD Consultant
description:
Über uns

teamative bietet Beratung, Entwicklung und die Umsetzung von IT‑Projekten in Europa und den USA.
 
Mit SAP und ServiceNow als Kernkompetenzen sowie maßgeschneiderter Softwareentwicklung und DevOps helfen wir dabei, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, digitale Lösungen zu implementieren und komplexe Transformationsinitiativen erfolgreich zu steuern. Darüber hinaus ermöglichen wir flexibles Staffing, damit Teams je nach Anforderung schnell angepasst werden können.
 
Rund 400 interne Mitarbeitende und insgesamt mehr als 750 Expert:innen verbinden bei teamative tiefe Inhouse‑Expertise mit bedarfsorientierter Staff Augmentation – sichtbar in langfristigen, vertrauensvollen Partnerschaften mit renommierten Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen.
 
So stehen wir seit über 20 Jahren für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Kosteneffizienz – in Stuttgart, Bratislava, Miami und über zehn europäischen Tech Hubs.


Stellenintro

Als Senior SAP SD Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Vertriebsprozesse und der Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA. Du analysierst komplexe Anforderungen, entwickelst passende SAP-Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse vom Auftrag bis zur Fakturierung effizient und durchgängig funktionieren.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Optimiere Vertriebsprozesse: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse im SAP SD und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden effiziente und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für ihre Vertriebsorganisation. 
  • Gestalte S/4HANA-Transformationen: Du begleitest Kunden fachlich und technisch bei der Einführung, Migration und Weiterentwicklung von SAP S/4HANA Sales. 
  • Verbessere End-to-End-Prozesse: Du gestaltest und optimierst den gesamten Order-to-Cash-Prozess – von Auftrag und Lieferung bis hin zu Fakturierung und Übergabe an Finance. 
  • Verbinde SAP-Prozesse: Du stellst eine reibungslose Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO, MM und weiteren angrenzenden Bereichen sicher. 
  • Mache Anforderungen zu Lösungen: Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen, führst Kundenworkshops durch und übersetzt Geschäftsprozesse in passende SAP-Lösungen. 
  • Übernimm Verantwortung: Du steuerst Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte eigenständig und unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei SAP-SD-Support, Prozessoptimierung und Weiterentwicklung. 


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP SD Consultant, SAP Sales Consultant oder SAP Key User mit fundiertem Verständnis von Vertriebsprozessen. 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP SD sowie idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA Sales. 
  • Gutes Verständnis des Order-to-Cash-Prozesses und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Themen wie Auftragserfassung, Lieferabwicklung, Versand, Fakturierung und Preisfindung. 
  • Verständnis für die Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO und MM sowie angrenzenden End-to-End-Prozessen. 
  • Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Anforderungsanalyse, Workshop-Moderation und Präsentation sowie die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare SAP-Lösungen zu übersetzen. 
  • Eigenständige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; projektabhängige Reisebereitschaft.


Warum wir?

title: Senior Content Writer (B2B SaaS)
description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts.

We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast.

First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet.

On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing.

This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree
  • Native-level English writing. This role produces English content for an international audience and the bar is publication quality.
  • Proven independent research. You have found data, worked with primary sources, judged what is reliable and built something original out of it. Bring examples.
  • You develop expertise fast. Hand you an unfamiliar regulated topic on Monday and you can hold a credible conversation with a practitioner by Friday
  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.
  • You write clearly, creatively and in an approachable, human way. No filler, no throat-clearing, no AI slop.
  • You bring your own ideas. You propose topics and reports rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Reliable, diligent and proactive. You take ownership of your work, meet deadlines and pay close attention to accuracy, quality and consistency.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience building benchmark reports, surveys or other original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress
  • Basic SEO understanding, including keyword research, keyword integration, headings, internal linking and content optimisation
  • You have already heard of AEO (answer engine optimization) and understand why it matters. It is our biggest growth engine.
  • Experience writing about regulated or technical subjects such as food safety, quality, EHS or logistics

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
description:
Your tasks

  • Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship.
  • Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved.
  • Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended.
  • Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next.
  • Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging.
  • From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly.
  • Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs.


Your profile

  • Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half.
  • Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people.
  • Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be.
  • Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic.
  • Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models.
  • Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement.


Why us?

  • Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers.
  • Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket.
  • Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

How to Apply

Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production: what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d)
description:
Projekte gestalten. Menschen verbinden. Digitalisierung voranbringen.

Du kennst IT-Projekte nicht nur aus dem Lehrbuch, sondern weißt, dass erfolgreiche Projekte vor allem eines brauchen: klare Ziele, gute Kommunikation und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Als IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns eine zentrale Rolle: Du bringst fachliche Anforderungen, technische Möglichkeiten und die unterschiedlichen Interessen unserer Stakeholder zusammen – und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen funktionierende Lösungen werden.Dabei geht es nicht darum, einfach nur Projektpläne zu pflegen.

Du gestaltest Projekte aktiv, triffst Entscheidungen, schaffst Orientierung und bringst Themen ins Ziel.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Planung und Steuerung unserer IT-Projekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe in den Betrieb.
Dabei kannst du dich auf abwechslungsreiche Themen und unterschiedliche Projektgrößen freuen. Ob die Einführung neuer IT-Lösungen, die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme, Digitalisierungsprojekte oder die Optimierung von IT-Prozessen: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Anforderungen konkrete Ergebnisse werden.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung:
    Von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss steuerst Du IT-Projekte eigenständig und behältst Ziele, Termine, Budgets und Ressourcen stets im Blick.
  • Du bringst Menschen zusammen:
    Mit klarer Kommunikation und verbindlicher Abstimmung verbindest Du Fachbereiche, IT-Teams, externe Partner und weitere Stakeholder zu einer verlässlichen Zusammenarbeit.
  • Du machst Fortschritt sichtbar:
    Durch prägnanten Statusberichten, Entscheidungsunterlagen und Management-Updates schaffst Du Transparenz und bringst Entscheidungen gezielt voran.
  • Du entwickelst aus Anforderungen Lösungen:
    Aus fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen entwickelst Du klare Strukturen und führst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zu tragfähigen Lösungen zusammen.
  • Du hast Risiken im Blick:
    Abhängigkeiten, Veränderungen und Projektrisiken erkennst Du frühzeitig und steuerst mit passenden Maßnahmen gezielt gegen.
  • Du entwickelst Dich mit uns weiter:
    Mit Deinen Erfahrungen, Ideen und neuen Impulsen gestaltest Du die Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden, Standards und Prozesse aktiv mit.

Für uns ist nicht entscheidend, ob dein Lebenslauf exakt einem bestimmten Muster entspricht. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Projekte wirklich voranbringen kannst.

title: Head of Product (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

 

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As our Head of Product (f/m/d), you'll shape what an AI-first product for the trades can become — and turn that ambition into products used by tradespeople across Europe.

We're moving beyond software that digitises administrative work towards software that increasingly does the work itself: answering calls a busy shop can't get to, turning information from the job site into quotes, keeping invoicing moving, and helping business owners understand where their attention is needed. The challenge is to make these capabilities part of one coherent product experience — not simply add AI features to an existing product.

The playbook for software that runs a trades business for its owner doesn't exist yet. You'll play a key role in shaping it.

And the timing matters: we already have a substantial customer base, we're expanding into new European markets, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. AI is fundamentally changing what's possible for our customers, while our existing scale means the decisions you make can reach real businesses quickly.

You'll lead our Product Management and UX teams and turn company strategy into focused product execution. You'll define where AI meaningfully changes the customer experience, drive priorities and trade-offs across our core product, AI capabilities, and European markets, and set the bar for products customers can trust even when the underlying technology is probabilistic.

At the same time, you'll shape how Product works at plancraft: developing a strong Product and UX organisation, bringing teams closer to customers and outcomes, and creating the clarity and ownership needed to move fast.

Your Responsibilities

  • Make AI the product, not a feature. Define where AI can fundamentally change how tradespeople run their businesses and translate those opportunities into coherent product experiences across our platform.

  • Set the bar for trustworthy AI products. Own how we approach AI quality, reliability, evaluation, and decision boundaries — ensuring customers can confidently rely on the capabilities we put into their hands.

  • Turn strategy into focus. Translate company strategy into a prioritised product portfolio and clear team outcomes, driving prioritisation and trade-off decisions across markets, platform, and AI.

  • Lead Product Management and UX as one function. Directly lead around nine PMs and designers, raise the bar on product thinking, develop their capabilities, and strengthen ownership across the organisation.

  • Build outcome-oriented product teams. Continue the shift from domains and output towards teams that own customer problems and outcomes, stay close to real tradespeople through discovery, data, and experimentation, and have the autonomy to act on what they learn.

  • Build for Europe. Scale the product across markets, balancing shared foundations with the customer and market needs that genuinely differ.

  • Create a product organisation that moves with clarity. Establish a pragmatic operating model, clear decision-making rhythms, and strong interfaces across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM — with product and customer outcomes as the measure of success and commercial outcomes co-owned with GTM.

The scoreboard — how we'll know it's working

  • Autopilot penetration & hours given back — the share of the real work (quotes, scheduling, invoicing, materials) our AI runs end-to-end and the customer keeps — not reworks — and the admin hours that hands back to every business.

  • Net revenue retention & AI-driven expansion — customers who stay and grow because the AI pays for itself, with usage- and outcome-based revenue as new capabilities land (co-owned with GTM).

  • Time-to-first-value, in every market — how fast a new business — in Germany, Italy or Spain — reaches its first AI-sent quote or automated invoice, with onboarding that stays light.

  • Feature impact ratio — the share of what we ship that actually moves its target outcome: the number that keeps us a product team, not a feature factory.

Your Profile

  • You've led product in high-growth B2B SaaS on a similar level, with PMs — and ideally UX/design — reporting to you.

  • You've built (AI) products where the intelligence is the value — not internal productivity tooling or a bolt-on feature. You know how designing on top of probabilistic, fast-moving models changes discovery, UX, iteration, reliability, and the economics of the product.

  • You've built and scaled software products across multiple international markets, and understand how product strategy, customer needs, and execution change as the business expands.

  • You turn strategy into execution. You have a strong bias to ship, make the necessary trade-offs, and own them.

  • You've moved teams from output to outcomes and led them through meaningful organisational and product change.

  • You lead directly and pragmatically — adding structure where it helps and removing it where it doesn't.

  • You're fluent in English (C1/C2); German is a real plus. You're based in Germany and can spend around minimum a week per month with the team in Hamburg (which can also be split across the month).

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for an experienced Product leader who combines strong Product craft, organisational leadership, and a bias towards execution.

You’re comfortable moving between strategy and the actual product: shaping priorities with senior leadership, developing strong PMs and designers, challenging trade-offs, and staying close enough to customers and technology to build strong Product judgement.

You’ll thrive here if you’re excited by the opportunity to shape an AI-first product at meaningful scale, evolve how a Product organisation works, and help build a product that can serve tradespeople across Europe.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch.   • Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.

  • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands.

Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects

title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
description:
About FION

European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly.

We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently.

We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors.

We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work.

You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders.

Tasks

Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact.

Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows.

Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models.

Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices.

Requirements

You bring:

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation

- Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules

- Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch)

- Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting

- An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets

Even better if you have:

- Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works

- Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation

- BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems

- Experience with open-source and commercial MILP solvers (e.g. Pyomo, OR-Tools)

- Experience with optimization techniques such as stochastic or robust optimization

- Experience building forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products

- German language skills (our customers and partners are German)

Benefits

Ownership, not tickets This isn't a role where the models are decided and you fill in the blanks. The forecasting and dispatch optimization stack is greenfield - nothing exists yet, and you'll design and build it from the ground up. At larger energy companies, this scope is split across multiple teams. Here, you own it all.

Real impact, fast Your code runs physical batteries that save real factories real money. You'll see results on a Grafana dashboard the same week you deploy.

Founding trajectory As FION grows, you grow with it - from hands-on builder to platform lead to head of forecasting and optimization. What takes 5 years at a large company, you'll have from day one.

Compensation

- VSOP (virtual shares)

- you participate in the company's success

- Berlin hybrid (remote from within Germany possible for the right person)

Send us:

- Your CV or LinkedIn profile

- A few sentences on why this role interests you

- Optionally: a link to a project, repo, or writeup that shows how you think about technical problems

We review every application personally and get back to you within a week. No automated screening, no ATS black hole - you're writing to a person, not a system.
