Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;)

"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen können."

– Christian

"Wer sich entwickeln will, der kann das hier bei uns, d.h. aber auch, dass man dies wollen und zeigen muss."

– Robert

– Manuela

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products

Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test pipelines using Patrol integrated directly into Codemagic and GitLab CI pipeline.

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen.

    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.

Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.

title: Chief Technology Officer (all identities)
description:
What to Expect

Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working.

As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO.

Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice.


This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany.


Your Challenges

  • Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points.

  • Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation.

  • Build a strong leadership layer, clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies.

  • Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies.

  • Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified.

  • Plan the Engineering budget and capacity. Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity.

  • Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance.

  • Make credible commitments with Product. Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments.

  • Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early. Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights.

  • Establish clear data contracts with Data. Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science.

  • Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board.


What success looks like

In your first year, you will:


  • Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems

  • Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings

  • Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence

  • Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective

  • Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality


Your Profile

  • You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition.

  • You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact.

  • You have led Engineering in regulated, security-critical or high-availability systems. Medical-device or digital-health experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • You have built and scaled cloud-SaaS products, ideally in a regulated environment. Health-tech or medical-device experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You also bring broad systems depth across backend services, web and mobile clients, APIs and integrations, data flows, observability, security and operations. Our exact stack is not a hard filter.

  • You currently work hands-on with agentic development workflows and can show how you used, constrained or rejected AI output and made it scale

  • You have shipped products that achieved meaningful customer and business outcomes and bring product judgement and pace, not only engineering rigor. You can challenge Product constructively, make business and technical trade-offs explicit and protect credible commitments under pressure.

  • You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself.

  • You are business-fluent in German and English.


A university degree or fixed number of years is not required. We care about demonstrated impact, judgement and responsibility you have personally carried.


Why Caspar Health?

title: Communications Manager:in | Content & Campaigns mit Schwerpunkt antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit bei GermanDream (m/w/d · Teilzeit)
description:
Die Position

BERLIN · ab sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 

Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage

Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr 


Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream.


Über uns

GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen.

Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate.


Deine Rolle


Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate.

Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen.

Du entwickelst Formate und Kampagnen in enger Abstimmung mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektteam und den eingebundenen Fachrollen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick.

So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann.



Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet

Content, Redaktion und Storytelling
  • Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.
  • Du bereitest komplexe fachliche Inhalte verständlich, niedrigschwellig und zielgruppengerecht auf.
  • Du gestaltest Texte, Posts, Kurzvideos und weitere digitale Formate rund um die Themen und Aktivitäten des Projekts.
  • Du erzählst Geschichten aus Workshops, Qualifizierungen, Kooperationen und Veranstaltungen und machst die Menschen und Perspektiven hinter dem Projekt sichtbar.
  • Du achtest darauf, dass jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll, differenziert und diskriminierungssensibel dargestellt werden.
  • Du passt Inhalte an die jeweiligen Kanäle, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken an.

Kampagnen, Social Media und Medienproduktion
  • Du entwickelst und realisierst Kommunikationsformate, Contenstrecken und Kampagnen im Rahmen des Projektes.
  • Du betreust die projektbezogenen Inhalte auf den Social-Media-Kanälen von GermanDream und sorgst für eine verlässliche Veröffentlichung.
  • Du planst und begleitest Veranstaltungen, Videodrehs, Interviews und Videoporträts, breitest Fragen und Abläufe vor und stimmst dich dazu mit allen Beteiligten ab.
  • Du begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen vor Ort, filmst selbst mit und sammelst geeignetes Foto-, Video- und O-Ton-Material.
  • Du schneidest kurze Videoformate selbst und koordinierst weitere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten.
  • Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf.
  • Du unterstützt das Community Management auf unseren Kanälen, wertest Rückmeldungen aus und hältst vereinbarte Moderations- und Eskalationswege ein.
  • Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze.

Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab.
  • Du holst rechtzeitig Informationen, Materialien und Freigaben ein und sorgst für klare Absprachen und nächste Schritte.
  • Du pflegst Redaktionspläne und behältst Veröffentlichungen, Termine und Produktionsabläufe im Blick.
  • Du strukturierst und pflegst Content-, Foto- und Medienablagen, insbesondere in Notion und Teams.
  • Du achtest auf einen konsistenten visuellen und sprachlichen Auftritt entlang der Brand Guidelines von GermanDream.
  • Du wertest Reichweite, Resonanz und relevante Kennzahlen aus und leitest daraus Learnings für die weitere Kommunikation ab.
  • Du bringst Erkenntnisse, Rückmeldungen und aktuelle Entwicklungen in die Weiterentwicklung von Inhalten, Formaten und Kampagnen ein.
  • Du machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn Inhalte, Termine oder Produktionsabläufe angepasst werden müssen.


Was du für die Rolle mitbringst

  • Du hast erste bis mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Kommunikation, Social Media, Content Creation, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit oder einem vergleichbaren Arbeitsfeld.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Storytelling, Sprache, Bildwelten und digitale Formate.
  • Du kannst gesellschaftspolitische und fachlich komplexe Themen verständlich und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Content, insbesondere Text, Grafik und Video.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Kreativtools wie Adobe Creative Cloud und CapCut oder arbeitest dich sehr schnell in neue Anwendungen ein.
  • Du kennst Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und LinkedIn und verstehst ihre unterschiedlichen Formate, Zielgruppen und Funktionsweisen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung, Begleitung oder Umsetzung von Videodrehs und Interviews und Social-Media-Produktionen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei parallelen Veröffentlichungen, Abstimmungen und Terminen den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen und arbeitest gerne im Team.
  • Du interessierst dich für Antisemitismusprävention, Demokratiebildung und gesellschaftspolitische Debatten.
  • Du gehst verantwortungsvoll mit jüdischen Perspektiven und diskriminierungssensiblen Inhalten um.
  • Du wohnst in Berlin und bist bereit, regelmäßig für Drehs, Workshops, Veranstaltungen und weitere Projekttermine innerhalb Berlins unterwegs zu sein.
  • Du arbeitest wertebasiert, inklusiv und diskriminierungssensibel.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.


Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn, gesellschaftlicher Relevanz und direktem Praxisbezug.
  • Ein Projekt, das antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit mit Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Lebenswelten verbindet.
  • Ein aufgeschlossenes, diverses Team mit Haltung und direkter Zusammenarbeit.
  • Einblick in die Umsetzung und Steuerung eines geförderten Bildungsprojekts.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.
  • Anbindung an unser Team und Büro in Berlin-Mitte.
  • 30 Urlaubstage bei einer 5-Tage-Woche sowie Heiligabend und Silvester frei.
  • Ein monatlicher Benefit: Du kannst zwischen einem ÖPNV-Zuschuss oder einem steuerfreien Sachgutschein wählen.
  • Dein Jahresgehalt liegt – je nach Erfahrung, Ausgestaltung der Rolle und individuellem Profil – zwischen 38.372,40€ und 46.899,60 € brutto bei 40 Stunden und wird entsprechend deines Stellenumfangs anteilig berechnet.
  • Die Stelle ist bis zum 31.12.2027 befristet – die Besetzung erfolgt vorbehaltlich der finalen Mittelzusage für das Projekt.


So kannst du dich bewerben

Sende uns bis zum 30.09.2026, 13 Uhr über unsere Bewerbungsplattform:

  • deinen Lebenslauf,
  • eine kurze Motivation – als Text oder Video – und
  • aussagekräftige Arbeitsproben, zum Beispiel aus den Bereichen Social Media, Text, Grafik, Video oder Kampagnen.

Die Arbeitsproben sind ein verpflichtender Bestandteil deiner Bewerbung. Uns interessiert, wie du Inhalte entwickelst, Geschichten erzählst und gesellschaftlich relevante Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen aufbereitest.


Wir möchten ein Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, das von unterschiedlichen Perspektiven lebt. Deshalb freuen wir uns besonders über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Biografien und Erfahrungen.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, ethnischer oder sozialer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Alter oder Behinderung.

Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, aber das Gefühl hast, dass die Rolle gut zu dir passt, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

As our Founding Customer Support Engineer you own what happens after go-live: you keep our customers' integrations running and their teams using comstruct every day.

You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work.

You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built.

  • Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you.

  • Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear.

  • Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll write the first version of it as you learn, with the founders and engineering behind you.

In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort.

  • Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich.

Dein Profil

Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).

  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.

title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

     

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level german speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Munich office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

 

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Munich office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: (Junior) RevOps Engineer - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About Langdock

Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology and adoption. We build a secure, model-agnostic AI platform that helps companies put AI to work across their entire organization. From chat and agents to integrations, workflows, and our API, we give teams the tools to augment and automate their work.

We apply the same ambition internally. We want to be the most productive company in the world, and that means continuously improving how we work, not simply adding more people to existing processes.

 

About the Role

Help Langdock understand what drives growth, and engineer the data foundations and systems that make those answers reliable.

We are hiring our first dedicated RevOps Engineer (Data & BI) to give Revenue Operations the capacity to own both commercial data architecture and the processes connecting our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams.

At Langdock, commercial teams are technical and dedicate ~30% of their time to building. This means frontline workflows are designed and maintained close to the people using them. RevOps shifts focus toward more complex cross-functional challenges: architecting our commercial data model, delivering robust BI, and engineering seamless inter-team processes.

Your ownership of the core data domain will create the room to scale growth projects, account handovers, CRM standards, and renewal/expansion architectures.

The role combines two core focus areas:

~70% Applied Data & BI: Connect commercial, product, and billing data, build reliable models and reporting, and investigate questions that shape commercial decisions. You will own initiatives from initial business questions through modeling, validation, and analysis, helping teams act on the results.

~30% Cross-Functional RevOps Systems & Processes: Help design and improve how teams collaborate - from lead lifecycle stages and Sales-to-CS handovers to renewal, expansion, and billing processes. Working alongside the functional teams, you will clarify responsibilities, define required data touchpoints, and turn agreements into working, automated systems.

Langdock moves fast. This split provides a starting baseline, while priorities will evolve as our product portfolio and commercial organization scale. You will also take on high-impact special projects around growth initiatives and commercial operations.

 

What you will do

  • Architect shared commercial data & BI: Connect customer, product, and revenue data across systems (CRM, billing, product databases, and GTM tools); maintain consistent core metrics; and provide reliable, actionable reporting.

  • Build in-house revenue & billing logic: Own and refine our revenue tracking, billing data reconciliation, and lifecycle metrics so leadership and commercial teams can rely on one source of truth.

  • Support commercial planning and measurement: Provide clean definitions and data models to inform company goals, quotas, commission/compensation structures, forecasting, and account development.

  • Investigate growth drivers: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, and Engineering to explore key commercial questions, uncover pipeline/expansion bottlenecks, and validate hypotheses.

  • Optimize GTM funnels & lifecycle workflows: Define clear cross-team handoffs (e.g., Lead-to-Opportunity, Sales-to-CS, renewals, and expansions), ensuring clean CRM hygiene and minimal friction.

  • Leverage AI and modern automation internally: Use Langdock agents, automation tools, and CRM integrations to eliminate repetitive manual operational tasks and feed internal learnings back into our product.

 

What we are looking for

  • You write clean, performant SQL with confidence and have hands-on experience combining data from disparate, sometimes messy sources into resilient relational models.

  • You treat data with an engineering mindset: you don't just write ad-hoc queries, you build sustainable data workflows, test edge cases, validate outputs, and document your work so others can build on top of it.

  • You think commercially and are curious about what makes businesses grow. You understand B2B SaaS mechanics and distinguish vanity dashboards from data that drives commercial decisions.

  • You have practical experience with CRM systems (such as HubSpot), modern billing data, and automation tools.

  • You build with AI. You have hands-on experience using AI and automation tools to solve real problems and streamline operational work.

  • You can listen to ambiguous business questions from sales, CS, or leadership, translate them into clear technical requirements, and communicate analytical findings with clarity.

 

Our Values

  • Calm urgency. We move fast without chaos. We stay calm, fix what matters, and avoid unnecessary noise. We focus on solutions rather than complaints and make sure sleep, health, and sports keep our decision-making sharp.

  • Ambitious execution. We love building fast and with ownership. We aim to be the most productive company in the world. Learning, shipping, and improving bring us joy. Everyone is expected to ask questions, take initiative, and deliver reliably.

  • Caring ownership. We care deeply: about each other, customers, and the world around us. We act with empathy, sincerity, and long-term thinking. And we have fun along the way while spending time in the office together.

 

The Environment

We work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves—gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. Health is not separate from work here; it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

 

Compensation & Leveling

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

 

When you apply

When you apply, we would love to see an example of a data model, analysis, or workflow automation you've built. Tell us what problem it solved, how it works, and what you learned.

 

Next steps

We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to meet you.

title: Solutions Architect, Defence, DACH
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

  • Technical experts in the field

  • Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

  • Product evangelists of Cohere technology

  • Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include:

  • Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

  • Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act.

  • Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams.

  • Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

  • Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

  • Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work.

  • Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

  • Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution.

  • Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

  • Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.

  • Working closely with our partners (system integrators, defence companies and sovereign cloud providers), who lead many of the larger deals in Germany, to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.

This might be for you if you have some of the following:

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

Why us?

description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

We're seeking a bilingual Management Accountant to serve as the cornerstone of our German accounting operations. This role combines hands-on accounting execution with strategic financial operations, ensuring seamless coordination between our German and US entities while maintaining compliance with both German and US GAAP standards.

You'll work at the intersection of day-to-day financial operations and cross-border business requirements, partnering closely with our Head of Finance, People Operations, external payroll providers, and local German accounting advisors to maintain accurate, timely financial reporting across our dual-entity structure.

What You’ll Work On

Core Accounting Operations

  • Manage full-cycle billing, collections, and accounts payable for German entity

  • Execute treasury and cash management functions, including inter-company settlements

  • Process and reconcile inter-company transactions between German and US entities

  • Partner with People Operations and external payroll agencies across Europe to ensure accurate and timely payroll accounting entries

  • Review payroll outputs from external providers and post journal entries to the general ledger

  • Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (accruals, statutory deductions, benefits) each month

  • Maintain accurate books and records in accordance with German GAAP (HGB)

  • Maintain dual bookkeeping across DATEV (German statutory books) and Rillet (global ERP), ensuring both systems remain accurate, aligned, and reconciled on an ongoing basis

Tax & Compliance

  • Coordinate with external German accountants (Steuerberater) to ensure accurate VAT returns and filings

  • Support annual tax compliance including Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer

  • Maintain documentation for tax audits and statutory requirements

  • Monitor regulatory changes affecting German accounting and tax obligations

US GAAP Reporting Support

  • Assist in reconciling German GAAP accounts to US GAAP basis

  • Provide monthly financial data and schedules for consolidated US GAAP reporting

  • Support quarter-end and year-end close processes for global consolidation

  • Help maintain documentation for US GAAP accounting policies and procedures

Process & Systems

  • Implement and improve accounting processes and internal controls

  • Work with ERP and financial systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy

  • Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure

  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Completed Ausbildung as Steuerfachangestellter/ Steuerfachwirt or similar accounting qualification; Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounting preferred

  • Experience: 3 plus years experience in accounting role(s), preferably in fast-growing companies or startups

  • Language: Full fluency in both German and English is a core requirement

  • Technical: Strong proficiency with accounting software and Excel; experience with ERP systems

  • Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Freiburg, Germany

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with DATEV and/or modern cloud ERP systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite)

  • Familiarity with both German GAAP (HGB) and US GAAP principles

  • Experience working in dual-entity or international company structures

  • Prior work with German Steuerberater and understanding of VAT compliance

  • Experience coordinating with People Operations and third-party payroll providers (rather than running payroll directly)

  • Experience in technology or SaaS companies

  • Knowledge of intercompany accounting and transfer pricing basics

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Berlitz has taught languages for almost 150 years, mostly in classrooms and with live teachers. Now we're putting that method in people's pockets. The Berlitz app connects structured lessons, AI speaking and writing practice, 1:1 sessions with human tutors, and visible progress into one learning loop on iOS and Android. We're launching it market by market, and growing it fast.

Our learners are professionals who need a language for their career. Some pay for themselves. Others get Berlitz through their employer, who wants proof the investment is working. As Senior Product Designer, you'll own major parts of the learner app, from the first minute after download to the moment someone books their tenth tutor session. You'll report to the Staff Product Designer for this area of the business, and partner as an equal with Product Management, Engineering, and our AI and learning experience teams.

What you'll be doing

  • Design core learner journeys end to end across iOS and Android: onboarding and placement, daily learning, AI practice, tutor booking, progress, and the path from free to paid.

  • Design for habit and momentum. Find out why learners come back, why they drop off, and what makes them feel progress, then build that into the product.

  • Shape how learners speak and write with AI: conversational interfaces, real-time feedback on pronunciation and writing, and the moments where an AI tutor should hand over to a human one.

  • Work AI-native every day. Use AI design tools and agentic workflows to explore, prototype, and produce at speed, while staying the human in the loop who decides what's good enough to ship.

  • Pressure-test every PRD before it becomes a design. Question the assumptions, find the missing edge cases, and sharpen the problem with your PM, instead of passing a brief straight to a tool and accepting what comes back.

  • Hold AI output to a high bar. Run rigorous evals on what AI produces for craft, accessibility, localisation, and brand fit. When you see the same problem twice, fix it at the source by updating the design system.

  • Run research yourself. Talk to learners often, run usability tests, read the analytics, and set up experiments that tell us whether a change worked.

  • Own the conversion and retention moments (trials, paywalls, upgrade prompts, reminders) so they earn revenue without costing the learner's trust.

  • Design for corporate learners too: employer-paid access, entitlements, and the progress their company expects to see, without making the app feel corporate.

  • Build with Berlitz's shared design system and help it evolve, especially the mobile patterns, motion, and micro-interactions a daily-use app needs. Keep it structured so that both people and AI tools use it correctly.

  • Design for many markets and languages from the start, including text expansion, right-to-left scripts, and accessibility.

  • Work closely with engineers to ship fast, then sweat the details once it's live.

What we're looking for

  • Several years designing and shipping consumer mobile apps that people use every day, with a portfolio that shows native iOS and Android craft.

  • Evidence that your design work moved retention, engagement, or conversion, and a clear view of how you measured it.

  • Strong interaction and visual design. You care how a screen feels in the hand: motion, feedback, and pacing, as well as how it looks.

  • Hands-on research and experimentation. You've run your own interviews and usability tests, and used A/B tests and analytics to make calls.

  • An understanding of B2B: how a product changes when the person paying isn't the person using it, and how to serve both.

  • Fluent English. Another language is a plus. We are a language company, after all.

  • Based in Germany, Switzerland, or Hungary.

Nice to have

  • A background in a learning, language, or content app, or another product built on a daily habit (reading, audio, fitness).

  • Experience with freemium and subscription models, including app store payment flows.

  • Experience designing for markets in Latin America or South Asia.

  • Experience taking work from AI design tools to code to the repo. That means pushing front-end changes yourself through pull requests and checking your work in iOS and Android simulators.

What we offer

  • A product that changes careers. Our learners need the language for a job, a promotion, or a move abroad. Your work helps them get there.

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
description:
Deine Rolle

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:

  • End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.
  • Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.
  • Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.
  • Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.
  • Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.
  • Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
  • Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
  • Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
  • Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares).

  • Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training.

  • Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen


Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst große IT-Projekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – agil, klassisch oder hybrid

  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace-Lösungen

  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen

Das bringst du mit

  • Websites, Intranets, Apps, digitale Antragssysteme oder Fachanwendungen: Du begeisterst dich für die Umsetzung von herausragenden IT-Projekten
  • Du hast 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von IT-Projekten gesammelt und kannst eigenständig Projekte leiten
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen oder klassischen Projektmethoden und rundest mit einer Zertifizierung idealerweise dein Profil ab (z.B. PMI/CAPM, Prince2, Scrum PSPO/PSM)
  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium 
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

title: Werkstudent Product Design (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest digitale Produkte gestalten, die von Millionen Menschen genutzt werden? Dann werde Teil unseres Design Teams bei Mobimeo.

Wir bei Mobimeo machen Mobilität einfacher, intelligenter und nachhaltiger – für alle. Zur Unterstützung unseres Design Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine:n Werkstudent:in für rund 14 Stunden pro Woche an unseren Standorten in Berlin oder Hamburg.


Was dich erwartet

  • Du konzipierst und gestaltest Wireframes, Mockups und interaktive Prototypen für unsere digitalen Mobilitätsprodukte.

  • Du planst, begleitest und wertest Usability-Tests aus und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungen für die User Experience ab.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unseres Design Systems und sorgst für ein konsistentes Nutzererlebnis.

  • Du prüfst Designs und Umsetzungen auf Barrierefreiheit und unterstützt dabei, unsere Produkte für möglichst viele Menschen zugänglich zu machen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in den Produktentwicklungsprozess ein.


Was wir suchen

  • Du bist in einem relevanten Studiengang immatrikuliert, z. B. Interaction Design, Kommunikationsdesign, Medieninformatik, Human-Computer Interaction oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.
