title: Senior Solutions Consultant (m/f/d) - Growth & Strategy
description:
The Role

This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work.
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth.
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market, initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows.What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage customer opportunities end-to-end, from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team.
  • Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets.
  • Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets.
  • Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network.
  • Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach, including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market.
  • As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities.


Your profile

  • You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation.
  • You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close.
  • You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit.
  • You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value.
  • You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities.
  • You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow.
  • You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time.
  • You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently.
  • You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events, typically up to five days per month.
  • A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us.


Why us?

  • You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done.
  • You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work, with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events.
  • The role comes with a strong fixed salary, with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow.
  • You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget, home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats.
  • You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like.
  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

title: Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Roland Berger. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Our offer to you

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

• Help define how we scale: processes, tools, talent, culture.

Requirements

• 5+ years in professional services (e. g. consulting, system integration, sales of complex products) or in a product-driven start-up or scale-up.

• Proven consultative selling capacity: you can win complex enterprise deals by advising, not pitching.

• Solid understanding of digital products: you like working with users and engineers alike and you can define requirements that engineers can make real.

• Thorough and pragmatic: you think problems through and deliver concrete results.

• Challenger mindset: you shape how clients and the market at large think about professional services sourcing and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders.

• AI-affinity: you actively use AI tools and understand the strategic implications of agentic AI for professional services.

• Entrepreneurial energy – you are drawn to building markets, not administering existing ones. Own entrepreneurial experience is a strong plus.

• Strong academic background, fast career progression, proven commercial impact.

• Fluent in German and English (DACH is our home market, while we expand internationally).

• Network power: you have and build valuable relationships easily.

Benefits

• Attractive compensation with fixed salary, variable component tied to the commercial success of your Vicos, and company shares (ESOP in place).

• Entrepreneurial key position in an industry-transforming company with direct impact on company results, the market, and your personal growth.

• High degree of autonomy in how you develop your client portfolio, work with Vico Leads and shape the product.

• Fast-paced environment with a highly talented team of diverse backgrounds and top-notch qualifications.

• Flexibility in how and where you work – remote and/or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Barcelona, Berlin, Seville).

Ready to shape a market? Then let’s talk about your journey as Director Business and Digital Product Development.

description:
Gestalte die Zukunft der öffentlichen Verwaltung mit uns!

Ayunis ist ein führendes GovTech-Startup aus München mit über 900 Kunden in der DACH-Region. Wir bringen KI in den Kern der öffentlichen Verwaltung - souverän, sicher und nah an der Realität. Unsere Open-Source-Plattform gibt Behörden und Kommunen volle Kontrolle über ihre Daten, ihre Modelle und ihre digitale Zukunft.

Öffentlicher Sektor? Klingt das nicht nach Bürokratie?

Das dachten wir anfangs auch. Doch schon nach den ersten Gesprächen mit Kunden merkst du, wie offen und motiviert die Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden sind. Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir machen die Verwaltung effizient, digital und zukunftsfähig.

Wir sind ~30 Personen und wachsen schnell. Die Menschen, die wir jetzt einstellen, prägen alles, was danach kommt.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Wir haben noch keine People & Culture Funktion. Du würdest sie aufbauen.

Kein Prozess, den du übernimmst. Kein System, das du pflegst. Aufbau von scratch, mit der Freiheit zu gestalten, was HR bei Ayunis bedeutet, und der Verantwortung, es umzusetzen. Das heißt: Personio einführen, Hiring-Prozesse strukturieren, herausarbeiten was unsere Kultur wirklich ausmacht und sie nach außen tragen. Und Ayunis zu einem Ort machen, an dem außergewöhnliche Menschen arbeiten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • HR-Grundlagen schaffen. Personio als zentrales HR-System mit uns einführen. Durchdenken, was wir wirklich brauchen - Onboarding-Flows, Vertragsverwaltung, Urlaubsmanagement und es so aufsetzen, dass es mit uns wächst.
  • Employer Branding von Anfang an verantworten. Wir sind ein mission-getriebenes Startup, das an einer der relevantesten Fragen in Tech und Verwaltung arbeitet. Hilf uns, diese Geschichte zu erzählen und zu leben - auf LinkedIn, auf unserer Karriereseite, in jedem Moment, den ein Kandidat mit uns hat. Mach Lust, zu Ayunis zu kommen.
  • Kultur bewusst gestalten. Wir haben eine starke Kultur. Dein Job ist es, sie greifbar zu machen: dokumentieren, stärken und sichtbar machen, was Ayunis besonders macht - gerade weil wir wachsen.
  • Hiring unterstützen, das die Latte höher legt. Mit Hiring Managern verstehen, was „großartig" für eine Rolle bedeutet, Prozesse strukturieren und sicherstellen, dass jede Kandidatin und jeder Kandidat eine Erfahrung macht, die sie weiterempfehlen würden - egal ob sie am Ende joinen oder nicht.

Qualifikation

Du passt zu uns, wenn…

  • du dich beim Gedanken, etwas von null aufzubauen, mehr freust als bei dem, ein bestehendes System zu pflegen. Du hast eine eigene Meinung dazu, wie gutes HR aussieht, und Lust, sie in der Praxis zu testen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten.

Deine Verantwortung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan.

Je nach Projekt bedeutet das:

  • neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen

  • komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen

  • externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln

  • gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations MVPs konzipieren und umsetzen

Wir messen dich nicht daran, wie gut deine Slides sind, sondern daran, ob du reale Probleme löst und messbaren Business Impact schaffst.

Rund um das „Altersvorsorgedepot“ entstehen in Deutschland neue Marktchancen.

Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung.

Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live

Du entwickelst die Economics, identifizierst geeignete Partner:innen, führst Verhandlungen, bewertest regulatorische und operative Anforderungen und bringst die gewählte Lösung gemeinsam mit Product und Tech in unser Produkt. Ein sauberes „Nein“ ist für uns genauso wertvoll wie ein Go-live – wenn die Economics oder Rahmenbedingungen nicht stimmen.

Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand).

Du entwickelst Business Case und Testsetup, bewertest Anbieter und Inventar, verhandelst Konditionen und bringst die Kampagne gemeinsam mit Marketing und Brand live. Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen.

Wenn du ein Problem siehst, wartest du nicht auf Zuständigkeiten. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel.

As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on everything from equipment design to production support.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated systems.

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance, reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of food industry applications preferred.

  • Technical Skills: Knowledge of manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques, familiarity with lean manufacturing principles.   • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop longlasting cost effective engineering solutions.

  • Operational Agility: A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

We’re building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively. Why us?

  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

title: Engineering Manager - Platform and IT & Compliance
description:
Engineering Manager - Platform and IT & Compliance

 
 

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 
 
 

About the Role

 

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams: Platform and IT & Compliance. Together, these teams form the foundation that everything at trawa runs on, from the cloud infrastructure powering our services to the security and compliance posture that earns the trust of our customers and partners.

You'll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, creating an environment where engineers thrive and do their best work. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will lead an established and growing group of talented engineers across two distinct but closely related domains.

At trawa, our culture is generally "office-first with flexibility", where most of us are in our beautiful Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to occasionally work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, spending minimum 3 days a week in the office.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

You'll drive the evolution of four key areas:

  • Scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS that powers our mission-critical services with high availability

  • Great developer experience through CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

  • IT operations and security, owning the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa's systems and data safe

  • End-to-end ownership of our compliance and audit processes, managing the implementation of frameworks like ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS 2, while coordinating with internal stakeholders and leading external audits

Our tech stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Python, TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, Incident.io

  • Primo, Vanta

  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of trawa's current tech stack, infrastructure, and security posture

  • Define and share a clear vision and strategic roadmap for the Platform team that enhances developer experience and productivity

  • Assess the current state of our IT operations and create a strategic roadmap to support trawa's growth

  • Assume full ownership of our compliance programs and present a 6-12 month roadmap for maintaining and strengthening our security posture

 

What We're Looking For

  • You have at least three years of experience in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup environment. You know how to lead across multiple teams, balance competing priorities, and create an environment where engineers do their best work.

  • Hands-on background in one or more of the following fields: SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or IT/Security Engineering

  • You bring deep experience in cloud engineering on AWS, working with infrastructure as code, cloud‑native patterns, and containerised systems. You’ve built or led large‑scale distributed services, with a strong grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency in modern cloud environments

  • Practical experience with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. You've either led or played a significant role in an audit or certification process

  • Clear communicator who builds trust and fosters collaboration across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

  • Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds and experiences can thrive

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

 
 
 

Why Join Us

 

🌍 Real impact - At trawa, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We value creativity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives.

 

🚀 Early ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

🤝 Mentorship that matters - Regular leadership sessions, cross-functional exposure, and engineers who are genuinely invested in your growth.

 

📚 Learning culture - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

 

🌐 Inclusive by design - We’re an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

🎁 Solid benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

title: Finance Process & Systems Lead
description:
Finance Process & Systems Lead

Our mission for you

Build the systems and process backbone of the Finance function in one of the most complex industries – and shape how Finance can be run differently.

trawa is transforming how mid-sized companies access green, intelligent energy. That means building in a market shaped by decades-old logic, extensive regulation, and highly complex data structures: 15-minute time series, PPAs, spot, futures, and direct marketing. All of this needs to flow into Finance in a way that is accurate, efficient, and scalable.

We're looking for a Finance Process & Systems Lead to take real ownership of how Finance operates, scales, and automates at trawa. This is a blue-sky role: you'll design our system landscape, redesign core processes end to end, lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout, and turn AI and automation from side experiments into core infrastructure.

You'll work closely with the Finance team across all functions, as well as Business Operations, Tech, Data, and other key stakeholders, to build the foundations that allow Finance to scale with the business.

What you'll own

Finance systems and IT transformation

  • Own trawa's Finance technology stack end to end – from today's fragmented landscape to a fully integrated stack built around a modern cloud ERP.

  • Lead the broader Finance IT transformation, including architecture, vendor selection, integrations, and the roadmap for our ERP, billing system, and future Finance tools.

  • Drive requirements, implementation, and go-live from the systems side. For accounting-heavy topics, you'll work closely with the Accounting Lead, who brings the required technical depth.

Process redesign, automation, and AI

Your biggest lever in the first 12 months will be to structurally redesign Quote-to-Cash for our energy business.

  • Redesign our core Finance processes end to end – including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report – with scalability, controls by design, and automation built in from the start.

  • Own the automation roadmap: define what gets automated, in which order, and with what expected return on investment.

  • Drive month-end close automation and establish time to close as a measurable performance indicator.

  • Turn AI and workflow automation into reliable Finance infrastructure rather than isolated experiments.

Data and the Finance–Tech bridge

  • Own Finance master data and the Finance layer of our data warehouse, from source systems and governance through to reporting-ready tables.

  • Translate energy-specific data – including time series, accruals, and portfolio pricing – into Finance-grade structures together with Tech, Data, and Business Operations.

  • Establish the data models, governance, and quality standards that enable reliable reporting and scalable Finance processes.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1 – Understand and map: Get deep into our business model, the energy market, and our Finance systems and process landscape. Meet key stakeholders across Finance, Business Operations, Tech, and Data. Map Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report end to end, and identify the most critical system and data pain points.

  • Month 2 – Take first ownership: Own the automation roadmap and deliver one meaningful automation or process improvement. Take ownership of Finance master data governance and begin scoping the strategic IT landscape and Finance transformation.

  • Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own the Finance systems, process, and automation roadmap end to end. Present a concrete direction and rollout plan for the IT transformation. Define the target data model together with the relevant cross-functional stakeholders.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • 6+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Finance Processes, or FinOps in a fast-growing scale-up. You've built and improved systems and processes – not just operated them.

  • A proven track record of redesigning Quote-to-Cash in a complex environment with multiple product logics, numerous data sources, high volumes, and regulatory complexity. You also have a solid understanding of Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report.

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience with a modern cloud ERP. You've personally owned requirements, process design, data migration, cutover, or hypercare.

  • Technical fluency to build, not just specify: You use SQL and Python in live workflows and are comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks, and direct data access rather than relying only on standard reports.

  • An AI-first mindset with a track record: You've redesigned real processes using AI agents and workflow automation and have hands-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, n8n, or comparable solutions.

  • Experience designing master data and data warehouse structures: You've established Finance data models, governance, and quality rules and worked with Tech or BI to build a commercially usable data warehouse layer, from source systems through to reporting-ready tables.

  • An ownership mindset and business-fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in the energy market, utilities, or trading. This will noticeably reduce your time to value.

  • An accounting qualification or background, such as CPA, ACCA, Bilanzbuchhalter:in, or Wirtschaftsprüfer:in.

  • German language skills.

Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, build instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs.

What we offer

  • Blue-sky design authority: Work in one of Europe's most complex energy markets, with the opportunity to design Finance infrastructure from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy stack or legacy processes.

  • A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority.

  • The opportunity to lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout: a milestone that will shape the company for the next decade.

  • The chance to build a truly AI-first Finance stack.

  • Direct contact with our founders and senior leadership.

  • A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, an L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, an Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant Berlin office culture.

title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You will:

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

  • Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.

  • Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.

  • Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.

  • Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

  • Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1

  • Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.

  • Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.

  • Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements

  • Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.

  • Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.

  • Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.

  • Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.

  • Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You bring:

  • Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.

  • Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.

  • Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.

  • Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.

  • Excellent written and spoken English

You enjoy:

  • Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.

  • Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders

  • Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

title: (Senior) Platform Engineer - m/f/d
description:
Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI

Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company.

For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on.

Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built.

You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work.

The role

Platform Engineers own the shared capabilities that Langdock's products are built on. They treat these capabilities as internal products: defining the interfaces other teams build against and remaining accountable for their reliability, evolution, and operation over time.

The work is to turn complex capabilities such as model access, agent execution, authorization, queues, integrations, document processing, and sandboxed compute into stable, reusable building blocks. Each capability needs a clear contract and must be able to evolve without forcing coordinated changes across the rest of the product.

You own a service from design through long-term operation. That includes defining its API and failure behavior, planning migrations, implementing and deploying it, making it observable, and responding when it fails in production. When a service requires a new underlying mechanism, you work with Systems Engineers while remaining accountable for the service boundary and lifecycle.

What you might work on

Current platform work includes:

  • A durable agent runtime. The current engine runs model and tool loops for Chat, Workflows, automations, and subagents, but active execution is still owned by one process. We are separating the runtime from product-specific state and designing durable runs that can wait for approvals or external events, recover after a process dies, and continue without repeating committed tool calls. This also includes deterministic context reconstruction, compaction, and prompt-cache efficiency.

  • The Model Gateway. We are building one inference boundary for every Langdock product, with a model-agnostic API over managed and customer-provided models. The work includes provider adapters, routing across accounts and regions, rate limits, bounded fallback, streaming safety, usage tracking, and a control plane.

  • Shared services with explicit contracts. We are moving selected capabilities out of a TypeScript monolith into independently operated services with Protobuf and gRPC contracts inside one Bazel monorepo. Our authorization service, written in Go with embedded SpiceDB, is one example: the migration uses an outbox, shadow comparisons on production traffic, and consistency tokens before it becomes authoritative.

  • The integration and tool platform. Langdock already connects to external services through REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication. The platform work is to make authentication, token refresh, rate limits, approvals, outbound network safety, and tool execution consistent across these paths.

  • Code execution as a shared service. Langdock already runs untrusted JavaScript, Bash, and Python through separate execution environments. Platform work includes defining a consistent execution API, lifecycle, permission model, resource budgets, and operational boundary, while partnering with Systems Engineers on the underlying isolation and scheduling mechanisms.

  • Production confidence for shared systems. Platform changes need evidence before rollout. Current work includes a reusable load-testing system for HTTP, gRPC, and streaming workloads; structured logging without user content or personally identifiable information (PII); and online database changes for PostgreSQL tables measured in hundreds of gigabytes or terabytes.

You will start in one area based on your experience and the team's priorities, then own its interface and operation in production.

title: Staff Core Platform Engineer
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80+ product engineers and our open-source community can build confidently across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

Architectural direction across Core Platform

  • Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.

  • Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

Execution, distributed systems & data foundations

  • Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.

  • Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.

  • Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long-term operational maintainability.

Platform architecture & engineering enablement

  • Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.

  • Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.

  • Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏗️ Staff-level architectural ownership: You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long-term organizational impact.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking: You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.

  • ⚙️ Configurable systems at scale: You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.

  • 🌐 Distributed systems depth: You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.

  • 🗄️ Data architecture at scale: You’ve worked on data-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript & Node.js depth: You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.

  • 🤝 Cross-team technical leadership: You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.

  • 🧱 Platform enablement mindset: You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.

  • 🧹 Long-horizon engineering: You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧰 Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience: You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure-heavy SaaS products.

  • 🖥️ Frontend platform architecture: You’ve worked with architecture-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.

  • 🧾 Durable execution patterns: You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state-management patterns.

  • 👥 Multi-tenant architecture: You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy-neighbour concerns were important.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.

  • 🧩 Monolith → modular migrations: You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.

  • 🧪 Strong CS grounding: You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.

This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.

Sound like the kind of platform challenge you want to own?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Head of Revenue Operations

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Head of Revenue Operations, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren General Manager Energy Solutions und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Unser Revenue Operations Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums gilt es nun, das Team gezielt für die nächste Wachstumsphase aufzustellen – sowohl für die weitere Skalierung in unserem Heimatmarkt Deutschland als auch für die Expansion in weitere Märkte.

Wen wir suchen

  • Revenue Engine: Du übernimmst die weltweite Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Revenue Operations Aktivitäten, durch die aus Leads verlässlich planbarer Umsatz entsteht

  • CRM: Du definierst die CRM-Architektur inkl. Datenmodell und Funnel Design, stellst systematisch die Datenqualität sicher, verantwortest Prozessdefinition und Governance sowie die Prozessautomatisierung

  • Tooling: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis der Sales Journey unserer Kunden und entwickelst sowohl customer-facing sowie internes Tooling, um die Effizienz und Conversion Rates unserer Revenue-Organisation strukturell zu steigern

  • Reporting & Analytics: Du ermöglichst ein zielgerichtetes Steering unserer Account Executive und Sales Development Teams durch Reporting & Dashboarding und deckst durch Analysen Optimierungspotenziale im Rahmen von Strategiediskussionen auf

  • CPQ: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für Angebotserstellung, Contracting und Commissioning, in dem du unsere Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen stetig weiterentwickelst und dabei auch eng mit unserem Tech Team zusammenarbeitest

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Sales Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut

  • Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner des Revenue Operations Teams etabliert - und bist im stetigen Austausch mit allen wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern

  • Du hast eine Strategie für Revenue Operations bei trawa entwickelt, klare Prioritäten gesetzt und eine Roadmap mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und Meilensteinen aufgesetzt, die unser weiteres Wachstum in Deutschland und die Expansion unterstützt

  • Du hast dabei insbesondere erste Optimierungsprojekte zur Steigerung der Conversion Rates sowie zur internen Prozessoptimierung angestoßen - und erste Ergebnisse sind in Sicht

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken

  • Du berücksichtigst bei deiner Entscheidungsfindung sowohl strategische Ziele wie kommerzielle Auswirkungen und kannst dich sowohl in die Perspektive von Kunden als auch von unserem Vertrieb hineinversetzen

  • Durch offene und wertschätzende Kommunikation, konstruktives Feedback und klare Prioritäten befähigst du dein Team, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

title: (Senior) Platform Engineer - m/f/d
description:
Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI

Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company.

For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on.

Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built.

You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work.

The role

Platform Engineers own the shared capabilities that Langdock's products are built on. They treat these capabilities as internal products: defining the interfaces other teams build against and remaining accountable for their reliability, evolution, and operation over time.

The work is to turn complex capabilities such as model access, agent execution, authorization, queues, integrations, document processing, and sandboxed compute into stable, reusable building blocks. Each capability needs a clear contract and must be able to evolve without forcing coordinated changes across the rest of the product.

You own a service from design through long-term operation. That includes defining its API and failure behavior, planning migrations, implementing and deploying it, making it observable, and responding when it fails in production. When a service requires a new underlying mechanism, you work with Systems Engineers while remaining accountable for the service boundary and lifecycle.

What you might work on

Current platform work includes:

  • A durable agent runtime. The current engine runs model and tool loops for Chat, Workflows, automations, and subagents, but active execution is still owned by one process. We are separating the runtime from product-specific state and designing durable runs that can wait for approvals or external events, recover after a process dies, and continue without repeating committed tool calls. This also includes deterministic context reconstruction, compaction, and prompt-cache efficiency.

  • The Model Gateway. We are building one inference boundary for every Langdock product, with a model-agnostic API over managed and customer-provided models. The work includes provider adapters, routing across accounts and regions, rate limits, bounded fallback, streaming safety, usage tracking, and a control plane.

  • Shared services with explicit contracts. We are moving selected capabilities out of a TypeScript monolith into independently operated services with Protobuf and gRPC contracts inside one Bazel monorepo. Our authorization service, written in Go with embedded SpiceDB, is one example: the migration uses an outbox, shadow comparisons on production traffic, and consistency tokens before it becomes authoritative.

  • The integration and tool platform. Langdock already connects to external services through REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication. The platform work is to make authentication, token refresh, rate limits, approvals, outbound network safety, and tool execution consistent across these paths.

  • Code execution as a shared service. Langdock already runs untrusted JavaScript, Bash, and Python through separate execution environments. Platform work includes defining a consistent execution API, lifecycle, permission model, resource budgets, and operational boundary, while partnering with Systems Engineers on the underlying isolation and scheduling mechanisms.

  • Production confidence for shared systems. Platform changes need evidence before rollout. Current work includes a reusable load-testing system for HTTP, gRPC, and streaming workloads; structured logging without user content or personally identifiable information (PII); and online database changes for PostgreSQL tables measured in hundreds of gigabytes or terabytes.

You will start in one area based on your experience and the team's priorities, then own its interface and operation in production.

Tech stack

  • TypeScript and a growing set of Go services in one Bazel monorepo

  • Next.js, React, and Tailwind on the front end

  • Node.js services and workers on the back end

  • PostgreSQL with Prisma; Redis with BullMQ

  • Protobuf and gRPC for service contracts

  • Kubernetes across GCP, AWS, Azure, and on-premises deployments

  • Terraform and Terragrunt for infrastructure orchestration

  • Datadog and Sentry for observability

You should be familiar with most of this. We trust you to pick up the rest quickly.

How we work

  • We operate with high trust and autonomy in squads of 3 to 4 engineers. A squad owns its roadmap, prioritization, technical decisions, and operation in production. Engineers are expected to find the context they need, ask for input when it improves the outcome, and move work forward without waiting for every next step to be assigned.

  • We align asynchronously before scheduling a meeting. Product requirement documents (PRDs) define the user problem, intended outcome, and constraints. Design documents make architectural boundaries, tradeoffs, failure modes, migrations, and rollouts explicit. People read and challenge the thinking asynchronously; once the context is shared, a short in-office discussion or whiteboard session usually resolves the remaining questions quickly.

  • We optimize for leverage. Engineers choose the AI tools that work for them, supported by clear ticket context, focused branches, automated tests, and AI review before human review. We also invest in observability, migration tooling, automated recovery, and runbooks so recurring product maintenance does not depend on someone remembering a manual step.

  • The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

 

What we are looking for

  • You have several years of experience, typically 3 to 6, building and operating backend systems under real load. You are strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable with Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, databases, and queues. Experience with Go is useful; willingness to work in it matters more.

  • You have strong platform design judgment and approach foundational work with diligence. You can define stable service boundaries and APIs while accounting for data integrity, tenant isolation, backward compatibility, partial failure, and safe rollout.

  • Given an underspecified systems problem, you identify the most important invariant, decide where to go deep, and defend what you deliberately leave out. You investigate unfamiliar components and failure modes until you understand the underlying mechanism.

  • You treat deployment as the start of ownership. You make systems observable, respond when they fail, and turn incidents into lasting improvements while moving with calm urgency and maintaining a high standard.

  • You use AI tools to multiply your output while remaining responsible for the architecture and every change that ships. You share context, ask for input, disagree directly and respectfully, and help other engineers succeed.

This is an experienced individual-contributor role. You should be able to independently investigate an unfamiliar problem, design a solution, ship it, and operate it in production. We generally expect this judgment to come from at least three to six years of full-time experience working on production systems.

 

Working here

This is an in-office role at Greifswalder Strasse 212 in Berlin. We work together in person because it helps us build trust, develop shared context, and make decisions quickly.

Most engineers start around 8:30. We usually eat lunch together, and dinner is available for people who stay later. Running and gym are part of the routine for many of us.

You need an existing right to work in Germany. We do not currently sponsor visas.

Compensation
